description: Validate the standalone astro-beginner-static-site copy with no env values or external services, run all validation commands, update catalog status in root README from 'pending' to 'in progress', and confirm the no-service gate passes.
steps: Copy astro-beginner-static-site/ to an isolated temp path (e.g., /tmp/standalone-test/astro-beginner-static-site)
Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in the isolated copy - must succeed without any root repository access
Run pnpm lint in the isolated copy - must pass
Run pnpm check in the isolated copy - must pass
Run pnpm build in the isolated copy - must produce dist/ with all pages and sitemap
Run pnpm test in the isolated copy - unit tests including Property 14 must pass
Run pnpm test:output in the isolated copy after build - all output tests must pass
Verify no .env values are required (build succeeds without any .env file)
Verify no external service calls are made during build/test
Update the root README.md: change the astro-beginner-static-site status from 'pending' to 'in progress' (change the emoji/text in the Beginner Static table row)
acceptance_criteria: Standalone copy completes all validation commands without repository root access
No environment variables required for build or test
No external service calls during install/build/test
Root README status updated to in progress for astro-beginner-static-site
pnpm validate (lint && check && build && test:all) succeeds in both original and copied location
verification: cp -r astro-beginner-static-site /tmp/standalone-test/ && cd /tmp/standalone-test/astro-beginner-static-site && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm validate
Check root README.md shows updated status for astro-beginner-static-site
